title: Los Angeles Wedding Guitarist | Moses Lin Music
description: Moses Lin is an award-winning Los Angeles wedding guitarist who specializes in live music for ceremony, cocktail hour and reception. Moses performs regularly in LA at venues like Calamigos Ranch and The Alexandria Ballrooms.
